procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
summary: Direct cash benefit of ₹5,000 in two installments for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second child.

steps.title: Register pregnancy at Anganwadi / Health Center
steps.description: Register pregnancy within 150 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP) and obtain MCP card.

steps.title: Submit Form 1A on PMMVY portal
steps.description: Submit MCP card showing at least one antenatal checkup (ANC) for first installment (₹3,000).

steps.title: Undergo child birth registration & vaccinations
steps.description: Register child birth and complete primary vaccination cycle (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis B).

steps.title: Submit Form 1B for second installment
steps.description: Submit vaccination completion proof to claim second installment (₹2,000).

steps.title: Direct DBT transfer to mother account
steps.description: Funds transferred directly to woman's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
